english.rationale: High-capability open-weight reasoning model for English linguistic review.

persian.rationale: Multilingual instruction-following model documented across 100+ languages; selected for Persian semantic review.

pedagogical.rationale: Distinct Google open-model family with reasoning for pedagogical evaluation.

adversarial.rationale: Qwen3 MoE reasoning/instruction-following/multilingual model selected as the adversarial candidate because it preserves the Qwen family while reducing worst-case Neuron usage enough for all frozen calibration repeats to fit inside the daily free-allocation budget.
